timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This is a 6v3 finishing game.
The purpose is to develop shooting and finishing opportunities in and around the penalty area.
The organisation is a pitch area of 20 x 20m with a 6m line from the goal marked with
cones.
Place 6 attackers of the three defenders.
Position target goals on the 20m line for the defenders to pass through if they gain
possession.
The rules of the game.
The ball is always served by the coach.
Game is conditioned to 6 attacking players for 3 defending players.
The 6 attacking players are conditioned to stay inside the game area, have no more than
two touches each.
Must have at least three passes before shooting and can only score outside the marked 6m area.
If the defenders gain possession they can score by passing or running on the ball between
the target goals.
Colting tips.
The attackers to create and find space to receive the ball.
Keep passing simple.
Awareness of turning and shooting opportunities.
Awareness of the position of supporting players.
Good attitude to shooting.
Re-bounds from the goalkeeper.
Angle, timing and speed of runs to receive the ball.
